title: Antenatal follow-up

user_facing_items.final_wording: Defines routine antenatal documentation, risk review at every visit, history and record review, patient concerns, shared decisions, counselling, care plans, and high-risk referral boundaries.
user_facing_items.population: Pregnant women and adolescent girls receiving pre-conception or antenatal care.
user_facing_items.setting: DoH-licensed healthcare providers delivering antenatal care in Abu Dhabi.
restrictions: Direct for routine antenatal documentation in Abu Dhabi; partial for high-risk or complication-specific care and for use outside Abu Dhabi.

user_facing_items.final_wording: Specifies gestation-linked weight, blood pressure, urine dipstick, fetal heart, fundal height, fetal movement, laboratory, ultrasound, glucose-screening, counselling, and follow-up documentation.
